title: Default empty chat sessions to sidebar-closed for main-pane space
description:
Problem: live `/chat` review showed new and empty chat sessions opening with the History sidebar already visible, even though there was no transcript content to justify sacrificing main-pane width. That made the first-use chat surface feel more cramped than it needed to be.

Desired outcome: fresh or empty chat sessions should spend their space on the main transcript/composer by default, while still keeping History and Trace one click away.

Scope:
- In scope: the default sidebar-open state and preserving explicit user-open behavior for History and Trace.
- Out of scope: changing chat history storage, trace semantics, or composer behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- Empty `/chat` opens without the History/Trace sidebar visible by default.
- The existing sidebar toggle still opens History and Trace on demand.
- Existing trace/history interactions remain able to open the sidebar when needed.

Validation:
- Run focused chat markup guards for the sidebar default and existing pending-write behavior.
- Browser-verify `/chat` on a fresh host and confirm the sidebar is absent until requested.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from the 2026-05-26 live `/chat` sweep: empty sessions were opening with the History rail visible by default, which consumed width before the user had any transcript content to review.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by defaulting `_sidebarOpen` to false in `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Chat.razor` while keeping `ToggleSidebar`, `ShowSidebarTab(...)`, and trace-selection paths able to reopen it on demand. Focused guards passed via `dotnet test .\MemorySmith.Tests\MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~ChatMarkup_ReconcilesApproveAllBatchOutcomesAndPendingState|Name~ChatMarkup_DefaultsSidebarClosedUntilHistoryOrTraceIsRequested" --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"`. Fresh-host browser verification on `http://127.0.0.1:5126/chat` reported `sidebarCount=0`, `toggleCount=1`, and `window.innerWidth=890` for an empty session.
